anomaliesAndSafeguards.sourceFile: Study Materials for First Midterm Exam.pdf
anomaliesAndSafeguards.observedIssue: Original option labels are printed 'a)', 'a)', 'b)' rather than 'a)', 'b)', 'c)'.
anomaliesAndSafeguards.requiredHandling: Preserve exact raw labels ('a)', 'a)', 'b)'); hold for parent approval before displaying a relabeled version. Never auto-grade by letter until resolved; grade only by canonical option ID.

anomaliesAndSafeguards.sourceFile: Study Materials for First Midterm Exam.pdf
anomaliesAndSafeguards.observedIssue: Student question on page 2 asks 'What is your complete name?'; answer-key reprint on page 6 says 'What is your name?'. Requests child's personally identifiable full name.
anomaliesAndSafeguards.requiredHandling: Keep page 2 wording in parent provenance record only; mark 'blocked_for_child' for privacy. Excluded from child-facing prompts and test denominators.

anomaliesAndSafeguards.sourceFile: Lesson 1 - I'm a Special Kid Worksheet.pdf
anomaliesAndSafeguards.observedIssue: Lesson 1 Worksheet C3 says 'I wake up ______ and get ready' with a word bank lacking the midterm's 'early' answer option, whereas Midterm L1 C3 provides '(late – early)'.
anomaliesAndSafeguards.requiredHandling: Preserve both distinct variants (`L1-WS-C-03` and `MIDTERM-L1-C-03`) and their own answer contexts; flag worksheet word-bank inconsistency for parent review instead of assuming identical answers.

anomaliesAndSafeguards.sourceFile: Study Materials for First Midterm Exam.pdf
anomaliesAndSafeguards.observedIssue: Source has 'I wake up ______ and happy. (lazily – energetic)' with awkward adverb/adjective grammar.
anomaliesAndSafeguards.requiredHandling: Preserve raw wording verbatim for original-source assessment; do not quietly edit to a different sentence.

anomaliesAndSafeguards.observedIssue: Identical statement 'Qatar hosted the FIFA World Cup in 2022.' appears twice (#5 and #8).
anomaliesAndSafeguards.requiredHandling: Preserve both source occurrences with distinct IDs (`QUIZ-TF-05` and `QUIZ-TF-08`). Do not count repetition as independent evidence of mastery.

anomaliesAndSafeguards.observedIssue: Quiz provides school-specific claims about Doha / Al Zubarah and names the UNESCO site as 'Al Zubarah Fort' (whereas UNESCO designation covers Al Zubarah Archaeological Site).
anomaliesAndSafeguards.requiredHandling: Preserve original printed questions and school keys; hold for parent/teacher historical review gate before narrating simplified assertions as independently established fact.

anomaliesAndSafeguards.sourceFile: Lesson 2 - My Family and I Worksheet.pdf
anomaliesAndSafeguards.observedIssue: School MCQs use a specific mother/father role framing in worksheet options.
anomaliesAndSafeguards.requiredHandling: Teach the expected curriculum response for exam preparation while depicting shared caring in videos and never asserting that only mothers care or only fathers earn.
